glsa.title: UnrealIRCd: Denial of service
glsa.synopsis: A vulnerability has been discovered in UnrealIRCd, possibly allowing denial of service.

background.p: UnrealIRCd is an Internet Relay Chat (IRC) daemon.

description.p: A vulnerability has been discovered in UnrealIRCd. Please review the CVE identifier referenced below for details.

impact.p: An attacker may be able to achieve denial of service.

workaround.p: There is no known workaround at this time.

resolution.p: All UnrealIRCd users should upgrade to the latest version:
